I just used a PH strip on this Donell lotion and it tested at PH of 5.....which is a neutral environment.  The higher PH means this lotion is not working at its full 20% potential. reviews.t: Be careful with usage but this is an AMAZING product!
reviews.x: I love this product! I  have what I like to call "strawberry legs" and this lotion has significantly improved my condition. However, it is extremely strong and I do not suggest using large amounts of it, everyday. Initially I applied this lotion every day after taking a shower and it made my skin extremely sensitive and red. However I reduced the usage to 3-4 times a week and it has worked wonders for my skin!

Hard, coarse skin is what I have, so I use this lotion to exfoliate my face 1-2 times a week. It's very effective & quick. I only need a tiny amount (pea-size) & it can sting fresh skin for a minute or two (it doesn't sting when my skin is coarse) & especially any current scratches or papercuts.  The bottle is large & lasts for years. Hard to find but well worth searching for & glad its available via Amazon.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the product for delivering visible results on skin concerns like melasma, sun damage, dry/scaly skin, KP, and crepey legs.
Many reviewers highlight the strong 20% glycolic acid concentration as effective, though some caution it is very strong and should be used carefully.
Several reviewers report using it successfully on both face and body, including around the eyes and on legs and feet.
A few reviewers question the product's authenticity or effectiveness, citing improper pH or receiving an unsealed, possibly fake product.
Reviewers frequently mention good value, long-lasting bottles, and satisfaction with the price.
